fields.title: ESPPRA tender/procurement record
fields.description: One record per row. Shape depends on recordType: TENDER_INVITATION (listType=tenders), TENDER_AWARD_INTENTION (listType=award_intentions), or SUSPENDED_SUPPLIER (listType=suspended_suppliers). Label-based fields are parsed from ESPPRA's own 'Label: value' paragraphs, so extra fields beyond those listed below may appear if ESPPRA adds a new one. A single _error record is emitted instead of payload fields when a page fails or is inaccessible.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: 'list:<listType>' for every record produced by this actor.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: Which extraction strategy emitted this record (S1-tenders-listing, S1-award_intentions-listing, S1-suspended_suppliers-listing, or 'none' on error).

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

_page.title: Page
_page.description: Which page of the listing this row came from (always 1 for suspended_suppliers).

_totalAvailable.title: Total available
_totalAvailable.description: Total rows ESPPRA reports for this listing, before any maxResults truncation.

_totalPages.title: Total pages
_totalPages.description: Total pages ESPPRA reports for this listing (server-fixed page size).

title.title: Title
title.description: The tender/intention's title as published by ESPPRA.

procuringEntity.title: Procuring entity
procuringEntity.description: The government body running this procurement. TENDER_INVITATION / TENDER_AWARD_INTENTION only.

referenceNumber.title: Reference number
referenceNumber.description: The procuring entity's own tender/intention reference. TENDER_INVITATION / TENDER_AWARD_INTENTION only.

procurementMethod.title: Procurement method
procurementMethod.description: TENDER_INVITATION only -- e.g. Request For Tender, Request For Proposal, Request for Expression of Interest.

tenderUploadDate.title: Tender upload date
tenderUploadDate.description: TENDER_INVITATION only -- raw text as shown by ESPPRA (e.g. 'Tuesday 28th July 2026 9:56 am').

submissionDeadline.title: Submission deadline
submissionDeadline.description: TENDER_INVITATION only -- bid submission deadline, raw text as shown by ESPPRA.

uploadDate.title: Upload date
uploadDate.description: TENDER_AWARD_INTENTION only -- raw text as shown by ESPPRA.

documentId.title: Document ID
documentId.description: The internal id ESPPRA attaches to the download link (numeric for tenders, sometimes the reference number itself for award intentions).

documentUrl.title: Document URL
documentUrl.description: Direct link to the tender/intention notice PDF.

supplierId.title: Supplier ID
supplierId.description: SUSPENDED_SUPPLIER only -- ESPPRA's internal numeric id for this debarment entry.

companyName.title: Company name
companyName.description: SUSPENDED_SUPPLIER only -- registered legal entity name.

suspensionStartDate.title: Suspension start date
suspensionStartDate.description: SUSPENDED_SUPPLIER only -- raw text as shown by ESPPRA (e.g. '17th Jun 22').

suspensionDocumentFile.title: Suspension document filename
suspensionDocumentFile.description: SUSPENDED_SUPPLIER only -- raw filename from the API; see suspensionDocumentUrl for the resolved link.

suspensionDocumentUrl.title: Suspension document URL
suspensionDocumentUrl.description: SUSPENDED_SUPPLIER only -- direct link to the suspension notice PDF.

_actionRawPlaceholder.title: Action column (raw, unreliable)
_actionRawPlaceholder.description: SUSPENDED_SUPPLIER only -- ESPPRA's own DataTable hides this column client-side; observed value is always an epoch-zero placeholder date ('1st Jan 70'), not real data. Passed through raw per this project's convention rather than dropped silently.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across all record types -- rows missing a given column render blank.
